author: Esquire2022
text:
I see why these people are getting sued. Total scam app. 

First, they will offer you trades (I.e., bets) on legs that are already good and have a O% win rate (but they only offer you the side that is 0% and not the other but they list it as 1%, I.e., you have no chance to win and they get free money;); for example I did not know Daniels was hurt and they had his line still for anytime TD at halftime and I bet it. He never came back of course and it never voids, and they still let me place it even after his injury (which I was not aware of at the time).  

Second, their customer service is horrible. The AI tries to continuously answer your question and not transfer you and then if you do try an agent they either (a) won’t respond for 6 hours then randomly pop in and if you don’t respond quick they close it, (b) they respond initially then vanish and close it, or (c) they never come. I have had all 3 scenarios above happen. 

If a player is injured and a reboot would normally occur within the bet (e.g. before halftime in NFL), and you bet on their over, they do not reboot or void it. And I have heard of you are on the winning side they do void it but not certain. 

Lastly, never have auto accept on. Their odds jump all over super randomly and I had it go from +300 to -400 for no reason. Nothing had changed at all in the game it was just a random spike. 

All in all, this app sucks dude and they are finessing (at least in Texas; where they have no regulator to answer too). Avoid at all costs homies!
